description: Lock the 2-wave fan-out structure of skills/ideate/SKILL.md (PR1 port of upstream ADHD). The skill is 2 sequential waves: Phase 1 (Diverge, 5 parallel Agent calls) + Phase 2 (Focus on host) + Phase 3 (Deepen, 3 parallel Agent calls). Peak concurrent = 5, at the F8.5 hard cap (orchestrate SKILL:420-427). The 2026-06-12 audit caught a 44→105-agent failure mode where a soft cap on a work-list was silently doubled by an audit + verify layer (memory/bounded-agent-spawning.md). This fixture fails if the load-bearing 2-wave callout is missing, if the Frames table is incomplete (any of 15 frames dropped), or if the Isolation invariant section is missing. Pattern: ideate-2-wave-collapsed-into-1.

evals.task: Verify that skills/ideate/ (SKILL.md body + references/frames.md) contains all 15 frame names. As of v0.2.113 the 15-row Frames table lives in references/frames.md (extracted to keep SKILL.md under the 500-line budget); a few frame names also appear in the SKILL.md body. The 15 frames are the load-bearing variety guarantee: hardware-eyes, regulator, ten-year-old, adversary, biology, logistics, game-design, markets, inversion, extreme-zero, extreme-infinite, remove-assumption, speedrunner, ant-colony, ops-3am. If any frame is dropped, the picker loses coverage and the ideation output converges to a narrower set of vantages.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references hardware-eyes
At least one of the checked files references regulator
At least one of the checked files references ten-year-old
At least one of the checked files references adversary

evals.task: Verify the 2-wave fan-out callout exists with the F8.5 cap reference and the 'Do not collapse' warning. The callout is the load-bearing guard against collapsing the 2-wave structure into 1 wave (which would either overshoot F8.5 or compress the algorithm). The route is a presence check on the word 'fan-out' AND the load-bearing 2-wave callout (the 'fan-out' word alone is ambiguous — could be any reference).
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references fan-out
At least one of the checked files references 2-wave
At least one of the checked files references collapse

evals.task: Verify the Isolation invariant section exists. This is the load-bearing algorithm property: parallel Diverge branches MUST NOT see each other's output (matches upstream engine.ts:251-258 Promise.all with no shared state). Without this section, the next LLM author will collapse the algorithm into a single thought.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references isolation
At least one of the checked files references invariant
